import.viewerBlocked: Only parents and owners can import data into this baby.

files.intro: Choose one or both Napper export files (up to {{limit}} each). Importing the same file again is safe: records that already exist are skipped, nothing is duplicated.
files.tooBigLocal: {{name}} is larger than {{limit}}. Export a smaller range and try again.

preview.notice: This is a preview: nothing has been saved yet.
preview.totals: {{total}} rows: {{create}} to create, {{existing}} already imported, {{skipped}} skipped.
preview.showSkippedFields_one: Show {{count}} detail that could not be read
preview.showSkippedFields_other: Show {{count}} details that could not be read
preview.hideSkippedFields_one: Hide {{count}} detail that could not be read

medications.none: No new medication names need a decision.
medications.intro: Napper stores medicines as free text. Choose what each name becomes, then press Re-check so the server confirms every name is covered.
medications.unmapped_one: {{count}} name still needs to be checked: {{names}}. Press Re-check after your choices.
medications.unmapped_other: {{count}} names still need to be checked: {{names}}. Press Re-check after your choices.

confirm.summaryBoth: Ready to import {{events}} and {{measurements}}, creating {{created}} ({{ignored}} ignored).
confirm.note: Everything is saved together or not at all. Importing the same file again later is safe: nothing is duplicated, and events you deleted are not brought back.

enrich.label: Enrich existing events
enrich.help: Fills missing sleep details and pauses on events you already imported. Never changes times or deletes anything.

errors.tooLargeServer: A file is too large for the server (limit {{limit}}). Export a smaller range.
errors.tooManyRows: A file has too many rows (limit {{max}}). Split it and import the parts one by one.
errors.invalidFile: The {{field}} file is not a valid Napper export (empty, damaged or missing columns).
errors.unmapped: Some medication names still need a decision: {{names}}.
errors.invalidMapping: The medication choice for "{{token}}" is not valid. Pick an existing medication or enter a name.
errors.conflict: Another import or sync wrote the same records at the same time. Nothing was saved; try again.
errors.validationFailed: The server rejected the request. Check the files and the medication names (up to 100 characters).

enrich.would_one: {{count}} existing event would get missing details filled.
enrich.would_other: {{count}} existing events would get missing details filled.
enrich.done_one: {{count}} existing event got missing details filled.
enrich.done_other: {{count}} existing events got missing details filled.
